# Greet the world

greet.sh prints `hello`. Make it greet the world: it prints `hello, world`, and test.sh expects that.

actions.name: merge
actions.label: Merge with git
actions.command: git merge --no-ff --no-edit norn/lt-1 && git push -q origin main

actions.name: kill
actions.label: Kill the agent
actions.command: kill -s KILL -- -<the process group of the running agent>

actions.name: fail-check
actions.label: Make the check fail
actions.command: commit a test.sh that always fails in the story's worktree ("norn lab: break the check on purpose")

actions.name: move-base
actions.label: Move the base
actions.command: commit a conflicting greet.sh and test.sh on main and push it to the lab's remote ("norn lab: move the base under the story")

actions.name: corrupt
actions.label: Edit a run-state file
actions.command: keep a copy of the unit's state.json in the lab's folder, then write invalid JSON over it

actions.label: Expire the claim
actions.command: rewrite the story's claim.json as another-machine@norn-lab.invalid's, expired a minute ago
